description: This file contains unit tests for the LoraProtocolAdapter class, verifying its behavior in handling provider routing, message processing, and error scenarios within the Eclipse Hono Lora adapter module.

classes.name: LoraProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LoraProtocolAdapter, testing message routing, payload handling, and exception scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, setting up a spy instance of LoraProtocolAdapter and stubbing common methods.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteSuccessfullyForUplinkMessage
methods.description: Tests that an uplink message is correctly routed and processed.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteSuccessfullyForOptionsRequest
methods.description: Tests that an OPTIONS request is correctly handled with a 200 OK response.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteDiscardsJoinMessages
methods.description: Verifies that join messages are discarded by the handler.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteDiscardsDownlinkMessages
methods.description: Verifies that downlink messages are discarded.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteDiscardsOtherMessages
methods.description: Verifies that messages of unknown type are discarded.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesUnauthorizedForInvalidGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Tests that missing user context results in an unauthorized error.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestForMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Tests that missing device ID results in a bad request.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestForMissingPayload
methods.description: Tests that missing payload results in a bad request.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestForInvalidPayload
methods.description: Tests error handling when payload extraction throws a class cast exception.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestInCaseOfPayloadTransformationException
methods.description: Tests that a MalformedPayloadException leads to a bad request response.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessageAddsProviderNameToMessage
methods.description: Verifies that the provider name is added as application property to the message.

methods.name: getLoraProviderMock
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock LoraProvider with predefined behavior.

methods.name: getRoutingContextMock
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock RoutingContext with preset user and response mocks.

methods.name: verifyUnauthorized
methods.description: Utility to verify that a fail call was made with Unauthorized status.

methods.name: verifyBadRequest
methods.description: Utility to verify that a fail call was made with Bad Request status.

methods.name: verifyErrorCode
methods.description: Helper method to check that the fail method was called with a specific HTTP error code.
